description: This file defines the 'LeaveEntitlement' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system, representing leave entitlement data associated with employees. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to the database, includes traits for additional functionality, and defines properties and methods related to leave entitlements.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlement
classes.description: Entity class representing leave entitlement data for employees, with ORM mappings, properties for entitlement details, and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days entitlement.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days entitlement, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of days used, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when entitlement was credited.

methods.name: setCreditedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when entitlement was credited.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlementType
methods.description: Returns the type of leave entitlement.

methods.name: setEntitlementType
methods.description: Sets the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the entitlement is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the entitlement as deleted or not.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who created this entitlement.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created this entitlement.
